QuestInfo.name: A Memory of Iron
QuestInfo.0: I need to let #b#p711##k analyze the scorched scroll to see if his alchemy can explain why Nyroth's machinery failed against the living malice.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p711##k discovered the soil is skewed by rusted iron from Tristan's ancient battle with the Balrog. I must defeat 50 #b#o58#s#k to clear the toxic air.
QuestInfo.2: I purged the #b#o58#s#k from the area honoring Tristan's memory and clearing the toxicity. But the living malice, #bCaligo#k, lies deeper.

0.0: Fascinating... This isn't just arcane failure. The ambient energy here is violently skewed by rusted iron and ancient blood.\nDecades ago, the legendary hero #bTristan#k sacrificed himself right here to save the swordsman #bManji#k from the #bBalrog#k.
0.1: Tristan's shattered sword acted as an iron ward, suppressing the beast's dark aura for years. But the Balrog's lingering malice has taken on a life of its own... an entity the fairies here call #bCaligo#k.
0.2: The local #b#o58##k have absorbed Tristan's rusted fragments. They are bloated on Caligo's malice. \nWe need some breathing room so we can continue our research.
0.3: Can you defeat #b50 #o58#s#k to clear out some of the harmful magic in the air? \nThey may very well return, but the time in-between then and now should be enough.

yes.0: Excellent. The pursuit of knowledge requires rigorous hands-on fieldwork!

no.0: A pity. Discovery normally waits for no one, but please return when you are ready.

1.0: Aha! You've done it!\nYes, my instruments confirm it. The magical density is dropping rapidly.
1.1: Tristan's physical ward is gone, but by purging the corrupted monsters from the area you have preserved his memory and given us room to breathe.\nHowever, my friend, we have only cured a symptom.
1.2: This living malice, Caligo, has taken root far deeper. The true nightmare lies at the absolute core of the World Tree.
1.3: You've done a great job today, but I'm sure the natives are in need of a strong pair of hands!

mob.0: The toxicity levels are still too high! Please hurry and defeat more #b#o58#s#k!
